name: @modelctx-ai/via
description: Call MCP servers as `via <provider> <resource>:<verb>` with on-demand discovery.

scripts.test:stateless: VIA_TEST_PROTOCOL=modern vitest run test/cli test/daemon test/client test/bench
scripts.test:conformance: npm run build && npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/conformance@0.1.16 client --command "node test/conformance/client.mjs" --suite all --expected-failures test/conformance/expected-failures.yml
scripts.eval:search: tsup scripts/eval-search.ts --no-config --format esm --target node20 --platform node --out-dir .build/scripts --silent && node .build/scripts/eval-search.js
scripts.bench:perf: tsup scripts/bench-perf.ts --no-config --format esm --target node20 --platform node --out-dir .build/scripts --silent && node .build/scripts/bench-perf.js
scripts.bench:tokens: tsup scripts/bench-tokens.ts --no-config --format esm --target node20 --platform node --out-dir .build/scripts --silent && node .build/scripts/bench-tokens.js
scripts.bench:eval: tsup scripts/bench-eval.ts --no-config --format esm --target node20 --platform node --out-dir .build/scripts --external @anthropic-ai/sdk --silent && node .build/scripts/bench-eval.js
scripts.split-stats: tsup scripts/split-stats.ts --no-config --format esm --target node20 --platform node --out-dir .build/scripts --silent && node .build/scripts/split-stats.js
scripts.split-diff: tsup scripts/split-diff.ts --no-config --format esm --target node20 --platform node --out-dir .build/scripts --silent && node .build/scripts/split-diff.js test/fixtures/tools test/fixtures/other
